caveats.en: Focusrite says Vocaster Hub is not currently compatible with Windows on Arm. Vocaster audio still works through the standalone Arm driver; only the control app is missing.
caveats.zh-TW: Focusrite 表示 Vocaster Hub 目前與 Windows on Arm 不相容。Vocaster 的聲音仍可透過獨立的 Arm 驅動程式使用，只是少了控制 App。

evidence.title: Focusrite: interface and app compatibility with Windows on Arm
